description.zh:
根据名称查询时，名称匹配策略：

- fuzzy：模糊匹配；
- exact：全匹配，等值查询。
description.en:
The name matching strategy when querying by name. Valid values:

- fuzzy: fuzzy match.
- exact: exact match.

description.zh: 负载均衡器名称，可以根据名称查询。
description.en: The load balancing name. You can query by name.

description.zh: 排序字段，现在只支持按id排序，id表示按id升序，-id表示按id降序，id大小和创建时间正相关，不传时默认按id降序排列。
description.en: The sort field. Currently, only sorting by ID is supported. id indicates ascending order by ID, and -id indicates descending order by ID. The ID value is positively correlated with the creation time. If this parameter is not specified, the default sort order is descending by ID.

description.zh: 分页查询时设置的页码。取值大于等于 1。
description.en: The page number settings for the paging query. The value must be greater than or equal to 1.

description.zh: 分页查询时每页的大小，取值范围 1-500。
description.en: The number of entries per page for the paging query. Valid values: 1 to 500.

description.zh: 站点ID，可通过调用[ListSites](~~ListSites~~)接口获取。
description.en: The site ID. You can call the [ListSites](~~ListSites~~) operation to obtain the site ID.

title.zh: 查询站点下负载均衡器
title.en: Query load balancers under a site

example.unifiedCli: aliyun esa list-load-balancers --page-number 2 --page-size 20 --name lb.example.com --match-type fuzzy --order-by id --site-id 216558609790000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun esa ListLoadBalancers --region cn-hangzhou --OrderBy id --SiteId 216558609790000 --PageSize 20 --MatchType fuzzy --PageNumber 2 --Name 'lb.example.com'
